evaluation: Separate leave-one-participant-out classifiers within each constant game; fixed balanced LogisticRegression C=1; fold-fitted StandardScaler
selection: No hyperparameter selection on these held-out scores
limitations: Small cohorts and source psychologist labels
Short-window RR statistics are exploratory; conventional-duration HRV may not be estimable
EEG/ECG artifact and time-within-game confounding remain possible
Offset sign is not independently confirmed; both signs reported
No FER faces, disgust or raga response labels
window_selection: Centered 30-second slice fully inside an annotation of at least 30s; identical duration for both labels
game_identity: Constant inside each independently fitted/evaluated task
secondary_analysis: Whole >=15s intervals are exploratory sensitivity only, not conventional HRV
